subject: INLA installation fails on Mac with R version 4.1.2

messages.author: a68f4a219f644d0b
messages.subject: INLA installation fails on Mac with R version 4.1.2
parts:
Dear Havard,

I've tried installing INLA with the recommended command
install.packages("INLA", repos=c(getOption("repos"), INLA="https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable"), dep=TRUE)
However, unfortunately it is not working at the moment, as I get the message

Error in download.file(url, destfile, method, mode = "wb", ...) :
  cannot open URL 'https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable/bin/macosx/contrib/4.1/INLA_21.11.22.tgz'

I've checked and currently there is no INLA_21.11.22.tgz file in the R/stable/bin/macosx/contrib directory.

The same command was working a few weeks before, so I was wondering whether this file has been deleted, or the 4.1 directory was updated recently.

Your help with fixing this would be greatly appreciated.

Best,
Daniel
